bring_to_front: Activate an exact app/window when the task needs visible foreground interaction. Prefer background input otherwise.
browser_click: Click an exact tab's current DOM ref or CSS-pixel coordinates. Background by default. Returns a fresh semantic page observation with new refs; observe_query narrows it and observe_after:false omits it.
browser_dialog: Inspect, accept or dismiss an exact tab's current JavaScript dialog using its dialog_id.
browser_navigate: Navigate an exactly bound browser tab to an HTTP, HTTPS or about URL without address-bar input. Returns a fresh semantic page observation by default.
browser_pointer: Hover, right/double click, scroll or drag in an exact browser tab, using current DOM refs or CSS pixels. Returns a fresh semantic observation by default; observe_after:false omits it.
browser_prepare: Connect a supported Chromium browser for DOM tools. For signed-in tasks use pid/window_id with strategy.kind:existing_profile; enabled Cafe computer use pre-authorizes this attachment and native debugging setup. For separate automation use allow_launch:true with profile.mode:isolated_new. Never use a new logged-out profile for the user's account tasks.
browser_set_input_files: Assign explicit local files to an exact tab's current file-input ref. Use only files the user requested uploading.
browser_type: Fill an exact tab's current DOM ref. replace:true replaces its value. Returns a fresh semantic observation with new refs; observe_query narrows it and observe_after:false omits it.
click: Prefer pid + element_token from a fresh window read for background AX clicking. Otherwise use pid/window_id with window-screenshot pixels and capture_id. Cafe automatically uses foreground after definite targeting refusals. Desktop pixels require scope:desktop.
clipboard_read: Inspect clipboard types; include_text:true reads its sensitive text only when needed for the user's task.
clipboard_write: Write exactly one clipboard value: text, an image path or a file path. Prefer targeted type_text/set_value for ordinary text entry.
double_click: Double-click a fresh element_token or window-local screenshot pixels in an exact pid/window_id. Background by default.
drag: Drag between window-local screenshot pixels in an exact window. Use an explicit desktop scope for foreground desktop gestures.
get_accessibility_tree: Read a lightweight desktop inventory of apps and visible windows before selecting an exact window.
get_agent_cursor_state: Inspect this chat's native agent cursor visibility, position, theme and motion.
get_browser_state: Read exact browser tabs and actionable DOM refs. Defaults to semantic_v2 without screenshots. Native binding also snapshots the uniquely active tab. Use query, scope_ref and continuation to narrow/page output. If the browser needs a connection, use browser_prepare. Unsupported browsers retain native AX/pixel control.
get_cursor_position: Read the real mouse pointer position in screen points; this is distinct from the agent cursor overlay.
get_desktop_state: Capture the desktop for system UI or when window targeting is unavailable. Defaults to a 1280-pixel long edge; request 0 for native resolution.
get_screen_size: Read logical display dimensions and backing scale for screen-point geometry.
get_window_state: Read a native window and its fresh element_token handles. Omit window_id to select a usable main window for pid. Tree-only by default: query searches up to 4000 nodes, otherwise 2000; max_results independently limits output to 200. Distinguish search_truncated from output_truncated. Request include_screenshot:true only for pixel grounding. Each read replaces the window's old tokens.
hotkey: Send a key combination to an exact window, preferring background delivery. Explicit scope:desktop sends it to the foreground app.
invoke_menu: Invoke an exact app menu path through accessibility, avoiding repeated menu screenshots and pixel clicks.
kill_app: Force-terminate an exact app pid. Destructive: use only when the user requests termination and account for unsaved work.
launch_app: Launch an installed app in the background by bundle_id (preferred) or name. Returns pid, a ranked main-window recommendation and up to eight usable windows. URL handoff is not verified navigation; prefer open_url for websites in the user's browser.
list_apps: List running and installed apps with bundle IDs, pids and state flags for native app launching.
list_windows: List ranked native windows and recommended_window. Tiny previews and completion windows are excluded by default; up to eight windows are returned. Filter by pid or query. Increase max_windows or include_auxiliary_windows to inspect omitted windows.
move_cursor: Move this chat's labelled agent cursor in screen points. Default window scope leaves the real pointer alone; explicit desktop scope moves the real pointer in desktop-screenshot pixels.
page: Browser compatibility actions for text, DOM queries and JavaScript on supported Safari/WebKit/CDP targets. Prefer exact-tab browser_* tools. Enabling browser JavaScript automation requires the user's separate confirmation.
press_key: Press one key in an exact window, preferring background delivery. Explicit scope:desktop acts in the foreground app.
right_click: Open an exact element's context menu through AX or window-local pixels. Use fresh element tokens; background by default.
scroll: Scroll an exact window in the background using its current element token or screenshot coordinates.
set_agent_cursor_enabled: Show or hide only this chat's native agent cursor; this does not grant or revoke computer control.
set_agent_cursor_motion: Tune this chat's agent cursor motion, effects and idle visibility. The native cursor respects reduced motion.
set_agent_cursor_theme: Choose an already installed native cursor theme and reduced-motion setting. Does not install themes.
set_value: Set an exact fresh AX element's value directly, avoiding focus changes and repeated keystrokes. Verify with a fresh read.
set_window_frame: Resize or reposition one exact native window, with independent geometry verification.
type_text: Insert text into a fresh AX element or an exact window's field. Prefer background delivery and element_token; window screenshot x/y can establish renderer focus. Cafe automatically uses foreground after definite targeting refusals. Scope:desktop types into the foreground app.
verify_state: Wait for up to eight bounded exact-window/element predicates without repeated screenshot polling. Images are optional; default off.
zoom: Capture a cropped window region for small pixel targets. Coordinates use the last window screenshot; from_zoom:true maps later input back to that window.
